'''Marble Aggelomoirai (palecore)''' is a [[Boss enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''. Alternate form(s): [[Marble Aggelomoirai (palesent)]]

{{Enemy description|NO PREVIOUS RECORDS. This has been classified as an Aggelos due to the nature of its formation. Though its morphic modules were re-assembled, the entity continues to mimic Nefarith's appearance. No satisfactory explanations have been proposed for this phenomenon.}}

==Overview==
A creation of Blight, made by [[Nefarith]], Marble Aggelomoirai begins fights in the '''Palecore phase''', during which it is invulnerable, immobile, and does not directly attack, instead relying on [[Marble Appendage]]s to deal damage. However, it will take 50 Stagger every time a Marble Appendage is defeated, and once it becomes Staggered, its core will be exposed, rendering it vulnerable.

Reducing its HP to 0 will trigger a cutscene where Marble Aggelomoirai [[Marble Aggelomoirai (palesent)|enters the Palesent phase]].

For unknown reasons, the Palecore phase is immune to {{G|Corrosion}}.
